text: Official SDKs for common web languages let developers add two-factor authentication without calling the Authy API directly
quote: So you don't have to use the Authy API directly to integrate two-factor authentication into your app, we provide an SDK for common web languages.

text: Migration guidance from Authy to the Verify service
quote: For more information about migration, see Migrating from Authy to Verify for SMS

text: 2FA tokens sync across mobile phones and tablets
2FA codes available on smartwatches, including Apple Watch
quote: On any device. Your phone, tablet, even your Apple Watch.

text: App available on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux
quote: It's available for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux.

text: 2FA data is encrypted and backed up to the vendor cloud, and the vendor does not store the backup password
quote: Encrypt your 2FA data and backup to our cloud, without storing passwords with us.

text: Backup feature restores tokens if you lose your phone, decrypting only on your devices with your password
quote: Use our backup feature incase you lose your phone. We encrypt your data, and only decrypt on the devices using a password only you know.

text: Access to 2FA tokens can be protected with TouchID, a PIN, or a password
quote: Use TouchID, PIN protection and passwords to protect access to your 2FA tokens.

text: Codes can be used to access secured websites without internet access on the phone
quote: You can still access secured websites without internet access on your phone.

text: 2FA tokens are generated on the device to avoid SMS and voice security issues
quote: Avoid SMS and voice security issues by generating 2FA tokens directly on the device.

text: Users can view, rename, and remove lost or stolen devices
quote: View information, rename, and remove lost/stolen devices.

text: Future Authy app installations can be disabled for extra security
quote: Disable future Authy app installations for improved security.

text: New devices are added through SMS, voice, or approval from an existing device
quote: Add new devices with SMS, voice or existing device approval.

text: Users can edit 2FA accounts and control which devices can access the tokens
quote: Edit your 2FA accounts and control devices tokens are accessed from.

text: Users can scan 2FA QR codes from Facebook, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Dropbox, and many other services
quote: Easily capture 2FA QR codes from Facebook, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Dropbox and many more.
